attempts.summary: Scheduled /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance to run daily at 02:15 on node1 via /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified the cron entry, made the script executable, confirmed manual execution appends correctly to the log, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified crond, the cron.d file, the script, and the log all survived the restart unchanged.
